products.name: Treat AI原生医疗入口平台
products.description: 患者通过聊天界面用自然语言描述症状，AI追问并结构化整理成医生简报，持牌医生审核并做出所有临床决策，必要时直接转诊或预约后续护理。

持牌医生审核并做临床决策
检查保险和雇主覆盖范围
患者数据留在欧洲经济区且不用于训练AI模型

evidence_refs.quote: The platform acts as a gateway to care, with patients first describing their symptoms in their own words via a chat interface, and an AI-powered intake tool structures the information into a detailed brief.

Patients can type or verbally state their symptoms, and the AI then poses a series of follow-up questions to gather the information the doctor needs. Treat’s system also checks their insurance and employer coverage so they don’t have to choose between a nurse, a doctor, or a specialist.

with the median time to a doctor’s review at just 2 minutes and 14 seconds during service hours

quotes.speaker: Sara Rywe
quotes.quote: Private healthcare across the globe is bogged down by fragmented systems and mismatched Incentives. Treat fixes this at the root. By stripping away billable runarounds and aligning technology directly with clinical workflows, the team behind Treat is building a new benchmark for primary care

quotes.speaker: Sami Marttinen
quotes.quote: Three years ago, my wife had to go through nine repeat doctor visits in private care before receiving a diagnosis. All the necessary information existed, but nobody had the incentive to connect the dots. The problem isn’t the doctors. It’s an economic model that rewards repeat visits over efficient resolution. Treat makes zero revenue from lab tests, clinic visits, or referrals. Our only incentive is solving the patient’s issue on the spot

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是Treat能否以“按结果收费”模式替代传统私人医疗按就诊量收费的激励结构，并验证雇主渠道的可规模化。当前融资所依赖的已验证信号包括：平台已完成超过108,000次医生审核聊天访问、62%案例无需进一步预约即解决、医生审核中位时间2分14秒，以及超过20家试点雇主。证据边界在于：83%首次就诊解决率为公司声称，累计215,000+聊天访问量来自官网且截至2026年8月31日，与新闻稿的108,000+存在口径差异；收入模式的实际财务表现未披露。
validated_signals: 平台已完成超过108,000次医生审核聊天访问
62%案例无需进一步预约即解决
医生审核中位时间2分14秒（服务时间内）
超过20家试点雇主，包括一家1,300名员工的公司
risks: 83%首次就诊解决率为公司声称，未经独立验证
官网累计215,000+聊天访问量与新闻稿108,000+医生审核访问量口径不同，需注意数据一致性
按结果收费模式的实际收入与留存表现未披露，商业化规模仍待验证
公司计划年底前进入5个以上国家，跨国扩张的执行与监管风险尚未验证
